WITH global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / t.Milliseconds) as ratio
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
),
media_type_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.Name,
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / t.Milliseconds) as avg_ratio
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT 
  mta.Name,
  mta.avg_unit_price,
  mta.avg_ratio,
  mta.avg_ratio / ga.ratio as normalized_ratio
FROM media_type_avgs mta
CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
WHERE ga.ratio IS NOT NULL
